title: Wild Vanilla
description: Wild Vanilla is a datapack designed to enhance the Minecraft Vanilla experience without altering its essence
body:
![Bannière](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/891e6475202ebf61fbba1a74a31c203f8aec4380.png) --- ###

Wild vanilla optimize and change the generation of Minecraft vanilla

--- ### **This modapack is actualy in beta phase and can be instable** --- ### Generation: Explore a world with a new generation style and more biomes to enhance the adventure. ### Appearance: This modpack includes a further render distance and a shader for a better look of Minecraft. ### Optimization: This mod pack optimizes Minecraft in the aim that the generation and appearance of this mod pack tend to run as well as the vanilla version. --- ### Content
